minutes.headline: APDC chair will oppose the large municipal building project only as a private individual; no commission position was voted.
minutes.summary: The commission mostly discussed the Municipal Building Design Committee's Town Hall/Ritter addition project. The chair opposed it as too large and costly, while the other members leaned toward supporting it. The chair also reported on OpenGov online forms and the planned merger of the APDC into the Historic Commission, which is awaiting town counsel review before going on the warrant. Minutes were approved and the meeting adjourned.

budget_items.what_was_said: The chair said the project presented to the select board is very expensive and much larger than envisioned in the original statement of work.

budget_items.topic: Town Meeting vote on the project
budget_items.what_was_said: The chair said that if town meeting in May does not approve the project, the separate chimney/roof and slate/gutter repairs would still proceed.
A member suggested a smaller project to address urgent needs might be possible instead.
The chair said the addition is about twice the size originally identified.

decisions.decision: The chair will voice any opposition to the building project as a private individual, not on behalf of the APDC.
Members were fine pursuing the merger first and any district expansion or authority changes separately later.
The chair will check the bylaw markup to make sure the membership-expertise language is kept, and will report back on counsel's response.

The chair described the Town Hall/Ritter addition as very expensive and much larger than the original statement of work.
The chair said that if Town Meeting in May does not approve the project, the separate chimney/roof and slate/gutter repairs would still proceed.
The planned merger of the APDC into the Historic Commission is awaiting town counsel review before it goes on the warrant.
The chair will check the bylaw markup to keep the membership-expertise language and will report back on counsel's response.

why_it_matters: The Town Hall/Ritter addition is a spending question that residents are expected to vote on at Town Meeting in May, and the commission charged with historic preservation took no position on it.
If the merger goes on the warrant, residents would also vote on whether the APDC continues as a separate body or becomes part of the Historic Commission.
